mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact permits arbitrary role-operation bindings in the permission matrix. LeastPrivilege checks that Unauthenticated has no permissions; without this fact, the assertion fails because Alloy can construct a model where Unauthenticated is granted operations. This directly tests the core authorization invariant from FR-001.

Removing this fact allows Tasks to be assigned to non-existent Members. FR_008_AssigneeIsCurrentMember asserts that every assigned task references a valid member; without the fact, Alloy can construct a counterexample where a Task has an assignee not in the Member set.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonexistentAssignee { some t: Task | (some t.assignee) and (t.assignee not in Member) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Tasks to have invalid creators (not in the Member set). FR_009_CreatorRecordedAtCreation asserts creator validity; without the fact, Alloy finds a model where a Task.created_by is not a Member, violating referential integrity from FR-009.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NonexistentCreator { some t: Task | t.created_by not in Member }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact permits TaskDeletion records to reference non-existent Members as deleters, violating audit integrity. Both AppendOnly and FR_018_DeletionLogged assert that all deleters are valid; without the fact, Alloy constructs a model with invalid deletions, forcing mutation detection.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidDeleter { some td: TaskDeletion | td.deleted_by not in Member }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Tasks to have status values outside the enumeration (Todo, InProgress, Done). FR_010_StatusCanTransitionFreely asserts all statuses are valid; without the fact, Alloy finds a task with an invalid status (neither Todo nor InProgress nor Done).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InvalidStatus { some t: Task | t.status not in (Todo | InProgress | Done) }
